cost.budgetScope: Accumulated since creation: first period, every manual/automatic renewal and restart, plus retained-data allowance (7 days of backups or 24 hours of paused EBS). Changing mode never resets this total.
cost.usageEnvelope: Traffic, requests, logs and management are separate allowances for each period, not measured usage.
cost.actualUnknown: Actual cost depends on traffic, logs and processing time; quotas do not cap AWS bills.
cost.pauseUnknown: Keeping paused data continues to incur storage costs after 24 hours, until resources are retired.
cost.extraUnknown: Long-term logs, older backups, shared infrastructure and unmeasured traffic are not included.
cost.limitUnknown: Paused storage beyond 24 hours, late processing, extra backups and actual traffic are not guaranteed to fit the estimate limit.
cost.pricesPending: Region and unit prices have not been approved. Environment creation cannot be confirmed.
cost.oldUnknown: Older backups, logs and shared infrastructure can continue to incur costs; actual data may exceed assumptions.
cleanup.pendingMetadata: AWS is still deleting {p0} ECS task definition metadata record(s). This metadata does not run containers or incur runtime charges; tasks, services, networking and retained backups are checked separately. It is not yet physically deleted.
quote.review: The estimate changed or expired. Load a new estimate and confirm it again. Your form is preserved.
continuous.name: Continuous use
continuous.explanation: The preview period is only for estimating costs. No ending schedule is created. Budget thresholds trigger alerts and preserve resources/data; they do not cap the AWS bill.
continuous.budgetWarning: Forecast threshold reached. Resources and source data are preserved. Review cost and end the environment yourself if needed.
upload.expired: The upload grant expired. Wait for the upload lease to clear before starting a new attempt.
upload.failed: S3 rejected the upload. Check the size, checksum and expiry.
upload.retry: Upload connection interrupted. Retry with the same file; the upload grant and operation key are preserved.
upload.limit: Maximum size for this configuration: {size} bytes.
upload.replace: Replace the current version of {key}? A different concurrent version will be rejected.
release.explanation: Upload a complete new draft before publishing. Activation switches this website only. The previous release stays available for rollback and may incur storage costs.
release.confirm: Confirm switching website content? Existing users may briefly see the old version during CloudFront propagation.
ledger.summary: Forecast: future reserved {future}; accumulated {accrued}; legacy awaiting reconciliation {legacy}. Budget cycle: project lifetime. These are not AWS charges or credits.
detail.restore: Restore creates a new environment in the original verified Region and configuration. Infrastructure readiness and data verification are separate checks.
upload.cancel: Cancel pending transfer / allow a new attempt
upload.cancelled: Pending transfer closed. Staging bytes expire automatically; live data is preserved.
quote.expires: This estimate expires at {time}. Confirm again after changes or expiry.
continuous.pricesUnavailable: Cost estimation is unavailable. Resources and source data remain active and may incur charges; ask the administrator to review pricing.
termination.review: Ending does not require available forecast budget or current unit prices. Confirm the existing data policy: pause keeps storage; retirement requires a successful backup retained for 7 days. Processing, backups, storage and logs may incur additional unpriced charges. Backup failure preserves the source.

upload.notVisible: The staged file cannot be verified yet. Retry the transfer or cancel it. If you already uploaded it, contact the administrator. Live data is preserved.

rec.latency: 95% of all attempts took at most
